1.2.0.name: ANATOMY
1.2.0.author: OTODESK
1.2.0.description: A high-performance VST3 plugin that performs Transient/Tonal audio separation using a cos-squared crossfade algorithm, routing each component through its own independent multi-effect chain
1.2.0.changes:
[V1.2.0] - 2026-09-06 (OTT×2 Dual-Stage & Workflow Upgrade)
Dual-Stage OTT×2 Architecture: Ported MULTI-OTO DSP engine with cascaded Stage 1 & Stage 2 processing, 4th-order Linkwitz-Riley crossovers, AVX2 SIMD RMS detection, per-band dynamics, and Align
